subject: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta

Team —

Quick background: Novanta (prospect -> now POC customer) is asking for an expanded publicity package as part of final contract economics. Their ask: 1) joint case study (we'd produce) + customer testimonial video (~2 min), 2) permission to use their logo across our website and press materials for marketing purposes, 3) a joint press release timed with launch, and 4) permission to reference high-level deployment outcomes (latency/cost-reduction percent). In return they're asking for a 25% one-year discount on the list price and a 12-month committed spend.

Two flags: they also requested we include a short blurb in our roadmap section referencing a future integration (non-standard) and asked that we retain their data for 36 months (also non-standard). They want fairly broad rights to the assets and preferred “perpetual” usage in their draft.

Can legal and sales leadership weigh in — do we have flexibility to approve 25% + the publicity package if we tighten terms (limited logo use, time-bounded rights, approval on final copy/video, and no roadmap mention)? If so, please confirm any additional concessions (co-marketing spend, exclusivity asks) that we should require. I’ve attached the draft case study and the customer’s proposed publicity terms.

Attachments: draft_case_study.docx, proposed_publicity_terms.pdf

Thanks —
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta

Neha / team —

Reviewed Novanta’s proposed publicity language. We can accommodate a marketing package but with firm limits. High-level legal guidance below: 

- Logo and name: limited license for marketing channels only (web, sales collateral, press), term = 24 months. No perpetual rights.
- Final asset approval: Novanta must have one round of review for the case study and final approval for the video (standard review window: 5 business days).
- No roadmap mentions or product-forward-looking commitments — redact any language that suggests future product delivery.
- Claims: any quantifiable outcomes (e.g., "30% cost reduction") must be substantiated in writing by Novanta or framed as "customer-reported."
- Data retention: 36 months is okay if it only pertains to marketing assets; however, we cannot alter production data retention/SLA in the commercial contract. Keep data retention for telemetry/logs in the platform contract unchanged.
- Indemnity/limitation: add a clause that Novanta will not grant us rights to proprietary third-party content. We should include a mutual publicity indemnity carve-out.

I’ve attached a redline for the publicity terms (redlined_publicity_terms.pdf). Key ask from legal: Marketing needs to accept the 24-month limit and the approval window; Sales leadership needs to confirm the discount and whether a co-marketing spend is approved. If Sales wants us to accept broader rights or longer terms, escalate to COO/CEO.

-Laura
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta

Neha — thanks for the thread and Laura for the redline. From a deal desk / revenue perspective:

- I can approve up to a 25% one‑year discount in exchange for a joint marketing package, provided we meet the following conditions: (1) Novanta signs the updated publicity terms (24-month logo use, approval rights, no roadmap language), (2) they commit to the 12-month minimum spend in the SOW, and (3) we secure a brief co-marketing budget commitment — recommend $15k to cover video production and amplification.
- No exclusivity beyond a non-surfaceable request — we do not grant vertical exclusivity unless it’s compensated. If Novanta asks for exclusivity or perpetual rights we escalate to the CEO for exception.
- Any request to change platform data retention or SLA terms is outside my authority and must be rejected or passed to Contracts for review.

If Marketing can sign off on the 24-month limit and the co-marketing plan, proceed to present the updated terms to the customer. Thank you.

— Vivek
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novantagroup.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the thoughtful conversation earlier. Per our internal review, we can move forward with the publicity package in exchange for the agreed commercial terms (25% discount for the one-year commitment, and a signed SOW for 12 months). 

Please see the key points we’ve agreed internally (attached as updated_publicity_terms.pdf):
- Logo & name use: Redwood may use Novanta’s logo and name for marketing purposes (website, collateral, social, press) for 24 months from execution.
- Case study & video: Redwood will produce a written case study and a short (~2 min) testimonial video. Novanta will have one round of review for the case study and approval rights for the final video (5 business days).
- Claims & metrics: Any quantifiable claims will be labeled "customer-reported" unless Novanta provides written confirmation of the metrics.
- No roadmap references: We cannot include references to Redwood’s product roadmap or future features in any public asset.
- Co-marketing: Redwood will provide up to $15,000 in co-marketing funds to support production/amplification.

Next steps: I’ve included a DocuSign link to the updated publicity terms and the commercial SOW. Once signed, we’ll schedule a project kickoff with Marketing to draft the case study and record the testimonial.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/novanta-rdw-1149
Attachments: updated_publicity_terms.pdf

Please reply to confirm or suggest edits.

Best —
Neha

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novantagroup.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Novanta Legal <legal@novantagroup.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer case study request tied to discount — Novanta

Neha —

Appreciate the clarity and the updated terms. Novanta is comfortable with the 24-month logo use window, the single round of review, and the framing of metrics as customer-reported. We have signed the publicity terms and the SOW (attached signed_publicity_agreement.pdf) and countersigned the DocuSign packet.

Next: Our marketing lead, Carla Mendez, will be your point of contact for the video. She’ll reach out to coordinate timelines.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Director of Cloud Ops | Novanta Group
Attachments: signed_publicity_agreement.pdf
